_doc: Marginal corporate tax rates by country. Damodaran's strict teaching: use MARGINAL tax rate (statutory federal + weighted state) NOT effective tax rate from the income statement. Effective rates embed one-time items, tax credits, foreign-income mix, etc. — all of which can revert.
_source: Statutory rates from country tax authorities + Damodaran 'Marginal Tax Rates around the world'
